mapper.select: SELECT * FROM sys_dict_item WHERE dict_id = #{dictId} AND status = 1 AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY sort_order ASC, item_id ASC

SELECT i.* FROM sys_dict_item i INNER JOIN sys_dict d ON i.dict_id = d.dict_id WHERE d.dict_code = #{dictCode} AND d.status = 1 AND d.deleted = 0 AND i.status = 1 AND i.deleted = 0 ORDER BY i.sort_order ASC, i.item_id ASC
